Phase 1 · Approval gate

Frame the Mandate

Agree on the world you are investing in and the rules you cannot break.

Decision question

What must be true about markets and each client before we are willing to invest?

Establish one defensible 12-month market view and convert each assigned client profile into an approved investment mandate.

Committee motion

Motion to approve the committee's market view and the investment mandate for each assigned client.

Phase 1 launch experience

Client Discovery and AI Decision Protocol

Interview the client. Challenge the first answer. Verify the evidence. Set the guardrails.

Open the discovery protocol Open the Analyst Decision Log XLSX

Workstreams

Market view

Read the historical data before using AI, compare the committee view with FactSet/FRED consensus, and build bull/base/bear scenarios.

Client discovery

Make a human-first judgment, interview the fictional client through the bounded AI protocol, and translate verified needs into RRTTLLU constraints.

Decision log and guardrails

Use AI to challenge the initial view, verify material claims, record final reasoning, and set criteria for later bonds, mutual funds/ETFs, allocation, and risk.

Required evidence

  • Human-first five-year macro read with source dates
  • FactSet/FRED consensus comparison and team forecast
  • Bull/base/bear scenarios with probabilities totaling 100%
  • RRTTLLU analysis for all three assigned clients
  • Return target, maximum volatility, and drawdown tripwire for each client
  • Analyst Decision Log showing initial judgment, AI challenge, verification, final reasoning, and downstream guardrail
  • Phase 1 decision record signed by all four members

Committee responsibilities

Committee seatResponsibility in Phase 1
Client and Macro StrategistLead the client interview, document goals and RRTTLLU constraints, establish the macro context, and name unresolved information gaps.
Fixed-Income AnalystTranslate cash-flow needs, time horizon, liquidity, taxes, and loss capacity into fixed-income questions and provisional guardrails.
Fund and ETF AnalystIdentify the client's diversification, access, liquidity, cost, tax, values, and vehicle requirements before screening products.
Portfolio Manager and Risk AnalystReconcile risk capacity and willingness, set provisional portfolio guardrails, challenge assumptions, and audit the Analyst Decision Log.

Approval standard

Gate 1

Approve or revise the common market view and all three client mandates. Portfolio construction cannot begin until the vote and action items are recorded.

The decision record must state the motion, evidence reviewed, each member's vote, any dissent or reservation, and the owner and due date for every required revision.
